S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_001.name: Chaos Unleashed

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_003.name: A Beast Cornered
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_003.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_003.desc:

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Magic_001.name: Dual Threat
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Magic_001.desc: Casting a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill also uses another equipped {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill at the target, dealing {c_random}[(0.5+0.03*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353892)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353892)/10)*0.03)*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Rare_001.name: Raging Chaos
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Rare_001.desc: While you are not {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}, you are {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}, your Skills deal Fire damage, and your Casts create a {c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c} for {c_random}[(1+0.1*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353895)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353895)/10)*0.1)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Fire damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Legendary_001.name: Deafening Chorus
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Legendary_001.desc: Your equipped {c_important}Shouts{/c} are now always active with {c_random}[(0.3+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353897)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353897)/10)*0.02)*100|%x|]{/c} increased effect, but your Maximum Current Fury is reduced by {c_number}20%{/c} per Shout equipped.

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Unique_001.name: Single-Minded Fury
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Unique_001.desc:
If you only have one Arsenal Weapon type equipped, gain the following:
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_random}[(0.3+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353899)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353899)/10)*0.02)*100|%+|]{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} Chance
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_random}[(2+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353899)-1)*0.1+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353899)/10)*0.1)*100|%+|]{/c} Increased Bleed Duration

S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Magic_001.name: Overabundance
S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Magic_001.desc: Every {c_number}100{/c} Spirit you generate above your Maximum increases your damage by {c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353901)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353901)/10)*0.05)*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds. S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Rare_001.name: Purge the Infected

S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Unique_001.name: Savagery
S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Unique_001.desc:

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Magic_001.name: Grim Reapers
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Magic_001.desc: Your Skeleton Warriors' attacks have a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to use {c_important}Reap{/c} dealing {c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353913)-1)*0.1+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353913)/10)*0.1)*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage instead of their regular attack.

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Rare_001.name: Decimating Desecration
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Rare_001.desc: Your Damage Over Time effects have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to deal {c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353915)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353915)/10)*0.05)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Legendary_001.name: Defile the Dead
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Legendary_001.desc:

Consuming {c_number}10{/c} Corpses grants you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Unique_001.name: Alter the Balance
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Unique_001.desc:
Your base {c_important}Core{/c} Skills are now empowered as {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills, cost no Essence, but have a {c_random}[30-(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353919)-1)-Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353919)/10)||]{/c} second Cooldown.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Magic_001.name: Unpredictable Alchemy
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Magic_001.desc: {c_important}Imbuements{/c} flow wildly, {c_important}Imbuing{/c} every {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill Cast with a random {c_important}Imbuement{/c}. {c_important}Imbued{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[(0.4+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353921)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353921)/10)*0.02)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Rare_001.name: Enervated Strikes
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Rare_001.desc:
You no longer passively generate Energy. 

Your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[(1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353923)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353923)/10)*0.05)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Legendary_001.name: Chaotic Grenades
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Legendary_001.desc:
Your {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} also trigger a {c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c}, dealing {c_random}[(1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353925)-1)*0.1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353925)==10?0.1:0))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Physical Damage. When you drop {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c}, you drop {c_number}1{/c} more.

{c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c} generate {c_number}5{/c} Energy if they hit an enemy.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Unique_001.name: Hit and Run

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Unique_001.desc:
Every {c_number}15{/c} meters you move grants you {c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353927)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353927)/10)*0.02)*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}5{/c} seconds. This bonus stacks, but does not refresh.

S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Magic_001.desc: Casting a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill increases your damage by {c_random}[(0.1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353930)-1)*0.01+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353930)/10)*0.01)*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}3{/c} times.

S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Rare_001.name: Advanced Techniques

S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Legendary_001.name: Mana-Infused Conjurations

S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Unique_001.name: Mana Shield
S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Unique_001.desc:
You have {c_number}99%{/c} reduced Maximum Life but any damage you would take is dealt to your Mana before your Life. If you have not taken damage in the last {c_number}2{/c} seconds, your Mana Regeneration is increased by {c_number}5000%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}.

You gain {c_random}[(2+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353938)-1)*0.2+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353938)/10)*0.2)*100|%|]{/c} increased Maximum Mana and each point of Intelligence also increases your Maximum Mana by {c_number}1{/c}.

S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Magic_001.name: Alacrity
S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Magic_001.desc: Your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills gain {c_random}[(0.1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353940)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353940)/10)*0.02)*100|%+|]{/c} increased Attack Speed, their dash range is increased by {c_number}50%{/c} and their {c_number}3rd{/c} attack now happens every {c_number}2nd{/c} attack.

S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Rare_001.name: Combined Strikes
S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Rare_001.desc:
Your base {c_important}Core{/c} Skills hit additional times in a larger area for {c_random}[(0.2+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353947)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353947)/10)*0.02)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage, but also have a {c_number}10{/c} second Cooldown.

S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Legendary_001.name: Back Off!

S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Unique_001.name: Convocation of Spirits
S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Unique_001.desc:
Casting a Non-{c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill has a {c_number}[Min(0.1,0.01+0.01*(Damage_Percent_Bonus_Per_Skill_Tag(1856650534)*(1+Multiplicative_Damage_Percent_Bonus_Per_Skill_Tag(1856650534))))*100|%1|]{/c} chance to invoke the Spirits of that Skill's types which deal {c_random}[(2+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353953)-1)*0.2+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353953)/10)*0.2)*100|%|]{/c} increased damage.

s3_temp_stone_active_006.name: Impale
s3_temp_stone_active_006.desc:
{c_label}Speed: {/c}{c_resource}1.5{/c} seconds
Perform a line attack to all enemies in front of the Seneschal Construct dealing {c_number}4,764{/c} damage.
s3_temp_stone_active_006.source: Acquired by defeating Heralds in Arcane Tremors

s3_temp_stone_active_007.name: Lightning Bolt
s3_temp_stone_active_007.desc: Launch a bolt of Lightning at the target dealing damage. Arcs to other targets dealing a portion of the original damage.

s3_temp_stone_active_008.name: Protect
s3_temp_stone_active_008.desc: The Seneschal Construct materializes a protective Barrier on the player for a portion of their Maximum Life.

s3_temp_stone_active_009.name: Reconstruct
s3_temp_stone_active_009.desc: The Seneschal Construct channels a reconstruction beam Healing the player for a portion of their Maximum Life over time.

s3_temp_stone_active_010.name: Slash
s3_temp_stone_active_010.desc: Pummel enemies in front of the Seneschal Construct dealing damage.

s3_temp_stone_active_011.name: Tempest
s3_temp_stone_active_011.desc: Electrically charge an enemy causing it to deal damage to themselves and additional each second over time. If the enemy is killed, Tempest spreads to another enemy gaining for additional time and bonus damage. These bonuses are also applied if Tempest is reapplied onto the same enemy.

s3_temp_stone_active_012.name: Flash of Adrenaline
s3_temp_stone_active_012.desc: Administers a quick flash of adrenaline into the player, granting bonus damage for a duration.

s3_temp_stone_support_001.name: Duration Support
s3_temp_stone_support_001.desc: Supported {c_important}Duration{/c} Skills have their durations increased by {c_number}4.0{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_002.name: Arcing Support
s3_temp_stone_support_002.desc: The supported {c_important}Arcing{/c} Skill can hit {c_number}10{/c} additional enemies.

s3_temp_stone_support_003.name: Gripping Support
s3_temp_stone_support_003.desc: Damage and effects done by the supporting Skill to Distant enemies pulls them towards the Seneschal Construct. Can only occur once every {c_number}10{/c} seconds per enemy.

s3_temp_stone_support_004.name: Voluminous Support
s3_temp_stone_support_004.desc: The supported skill's effect size is increased by {c_number}50%{/c}.

s3_temp_stone_support_005.name: Fortify Support
s3_temp_stone_support_005.desc: When the Seneschal Construct uses the supported Skill, you gain {c_number}123{/c} {c_important}Fortify{/c}. Skills with slower attack speeds or skills with cooldowns will increase the amount of {c_important}Fortify{/c} granted.

s3_temp_stone_support_006.name: Initiative Support
s3_temp_stone_support_006.desc: The supported Skill will cause the Seneschal Construct to teleport to the target if out of range. Can only occur once every {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_007.name: Safeguard Support
s3_temp_stone_support_007.desc: When used, the supported Skill grants {c_number}15.0%{/c} Damage Reduction to you for {c_number}3.0{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_009.name: Evernight
s3_temp_stone_support_009.desc: The supported Skill grants you {c_number}+4{/c} to all Skills when used for {c_number}2.0{/c} seconds.
s3_temp_stone_support_009.source: Acquired by defeating the Echo of Malphas

s3_temp_stone_support_010.name: Breaking Support
s3_temp_stone_support_010.desc: Damage from the supported Skill instantly destroys enemy Barrier effects. In addition, there is a chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 2 seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_011.name: Tactical Support
s3_temp_stone_support_011.desc: Decrease the cooldown of the supported Skill.

s3_temp_stone_support_012.name: Efficiency Support
s3_temp_stone_support_012.desc: When the supporting skill deals damage, you gain a {c_number}15%{/c} Critical Strike Chance to the same targets hit for {c_number}3.0{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_013.name: Devastation Support
s3_temp_stone_support_013.desc: Supported Skill gains a {c_number}75%{/c} Critical Strike Damage bonus.

s3_temp_stone_support_014.name: Resource Support
s3_temp_stone_support_014.desc: Player gains {c_number}14{/c} Primary Resource when the supporting Skill first deals damage.

s3_temp_stone_support_015.name: Frigid Support
s3_temp_stone_support_015.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage dealt is applied as Cold damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds and applies {c_number}35%{/c} Chill.

s3_temp_stone_support_016.name: Burning Support
s3_temp_stone_support_016.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage is applied as Burning damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds. Burning enemies take {c_number}[40|%x|]{/c} bonus Critical Strike Damage from the Seneschal Construct.

s3_temp_stone_support_017.name: Electrocution Support
s3_temp_stone_support_017.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Lightning damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds and has a {c_number}15%{/c} chance to Stun enemies for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

s3_temp_stone_support_018.name: Bleeding Support
s3_temp_stone_support_018.desc: {c_number}50%{/c} of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Bleeding damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds. Enemies take {c_number}[30|%x|]{/c} bonus Bleeding damage from all sources while moving.

s3_temp_stone_support_019.name: Poison Support
s3_temp_stone_support_019.desc: A portion of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Poison damage over time. This poison has a chance each second to spread all Poison damage to an additional enemy.

s3_temp_stone_support_020.name: Dusk Support
s3_temp_stone_support_020.desc: A{c_number}50%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage dealt is applied as Shadow damage over {c_number}5.0{/c} seconds. Afflicted enemies who attack have a {c_number}15.0%{/c} chance for their attacks to be interrupted. Does not interrupt Bosses.

s3_temp_stone_support_021.name: Swift Support
s3_temp_stone_support_021.desc: The supported Skill gains a {c_number}40%{/c} Attack Speed bonus.

s3_temp_stone_support_022.name: Slowing Support
s3_temp_stone_support_022.desc: Damage from the supported Skill Slows enemy movement speed for {c_number}2{/c} seconds. The closer the enemy is to the Seneschal Construct, the greater the Slow amount. From {c_number}30%{/c} up to a maximum of {c_number}80%{/c} Slow to close enemies.

s3_temp_stone_support_023.name: Mockery Support
s3_temp_stone_support_023.desc: Damage done by the supporting Skill Taunts enemies hit for a {c_number}4.0{/c} seconds. This can only occur once every {c_number}15{/c} seconds per enemy. Does not work on bosses.

s3_temp_stone_support_024.name: Registered Damage Support
s3_temp_stone_support_024.desc: Any damage caused from the supported Skill is registered. The registered damage explodes at {c_number}50%{/c} effectiveness when the target dies as Fire damage.

s3_temp_stone_support_025.name: Multishot Support
s3_temp_stone_support_025.desc: Supported Projectile skills launch additional projectiles.

s3_temp_stone_support_026.name: Piercing Support
s3_temp_stone_support_026.desc: The supported {c_important}Projectile{/c} Skill will pierce up to 11 enemies.

s3_temp_stone_support_027.name: Seeking Support
s3_temp_stone_support_027.desc: The supported Projectile Skill will auto-seek enemies for a limited duration.
